def transform(grid):
    import collections
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); c=collections.Counter(x for row in grid for x in row); c.pop(0,None)
    inner=min(c,key=c.get)
    pts=[(r,j) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==inner]
    k=max(1,(max(max(r for r,j in pts)-min(r for r,j in pts)+1,max(j for r,j in pts)-min(j for r,j in pts)+1)+1)//2)
    other=[x for x in c if x!=inner]
    frame=other[0]
    pts2=[(r,j) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==frame]
    a,b=min(r for r,j in pts2),max(r for r,j in pts2); x,y=min(j for r,j in pts2),max(j for r,j in pts2)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0,a-k),min(h,b+k+1)):
      for j in range(max(0,x-k),min(w,y+k+1)):
       if out[r][j]==0: out[r][j]=inner
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    colors={x for row in grid for x in row if x}
    inner=min(colors, key=lambda c: sum(v==c for row in grid for v in row))
    frame=next(c for c in colors if c!=inner)
    pts=[(r,j) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==inner]
    k=max(r for r,j in pts)-min(r for r,j in pts)+1
    q=[(r,j) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==frame]
    a,b=min(r for r,j in q),max(r for r,j in q); x,y=min(j for r,j in q),max(j for r,j in q)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0,a-k),min(h,b+k+1)):
        for j in range(max(0,x-k),min(w,y+k+1)):
            if out[r][j]==0: out[r][j]=inner
    return out
